programs.title: Blue Planet 2
programs.desc: For centuries, humanity has believed that the oceans are so vast and their inhabitants are so numerous that human activity cannot harm them.It is now known that this is not true.The existence of many animal species associated with the ocean ecosystem is at risk.This is clearly visible in the example of herring.Overfishing wiped out their population 50 years ago.Currently, thanks to good management, it has been reborn.Human-made noise, industrial pollution and plastic waste also negatively impact ocean life.In turn, more than 2/3 of the world's coral reefs have suffered from global warming.Recent research has revealed that the chemical composition of ocean waters is changing.They become acidic due to carbon dioxide dissolving in them.

programs.title: The Future of Nature
programs.desc: We will meet scientists, naturalists and activists who are trying to reduce carbon dioxide emissions to ensure the optimal functioning of natural ecosystems and stop global warming.

programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are UK
programs.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: Wonders of the Human Body with Michael Mosley
programs.desc: Using the latest achievements in science and medicine, host Michael Mosley delves into the interior of the human body to discover its secrets.In each episode, he explores new discoveries that significantly change our perception.From the possibility of 3D printing organs to gene therapies promising to reverse blindness.Throughout the series, he provides additional information in his characteristic way, offering his body to perform groundbreaking demonstrations.Created by an award-winning team, the series is full of visuals and fascinating facts.

programs.title: Surgeons: A Matter Of Life Or Death
programs.desc: More stories of life-saving operations in one of the largest hospitals in Great Britain.The series shows up close the activities and work of surgeons with extraordinary skills.
